asks.prefill:
Review the section open in the editor for completeness, scientific writing, citations, unsupported claims and contradictions. Run critique_draft on the text you actually read and identify remedies by severity and location.

When an authoring document is open, first call critique_document with its exact saved document_id from screen context and offset=0. Follow every nextOffset with the returned snapshotSha256 as expected_snapshot and unchanged review options, including template-source and template-reference items. Honor the recorded template identity, filingContext, aiDraftable, authoringMode, limitations and exact section guidance even if the working document was renamed. Recorded filingContext identifies the registry filing, region and agency; GLOBAL component guidance does not establish a receiving jurisdiction. Confirm the actual product, filing operation and receiving market before regional preparation; do not infer them from a title, module or company type. Guidance is reference context, not authored evidence or checklist completion. If needed, use get_document_template with that exact template_id and follow its pages for current reference; current guidance does not replace recorded limits. For a preparation worksheet, propose only source-supported preparation text and checks; retain the original official form, dataset, certificate or signed record and never synthesize or claim to replace it. If source metadata or guidance is missing, malformed or unavailable, report the gap rather than infer drafting eligibility from a name or module. Saved-review writing scores do not verify original records, regulatory completeness, approval or filing readiness.

Work on the saved records in the open project; unsaved editor changes are not included. Use list_authoring_outline and read_authoring_section to read the relevant saved text, following every nextCursor and nextOffset needed. Distinguish pending tracked suggestions from accepted document text. Read project Vault and data catalogue evidence with list_project_documents, search_project_documents and read_project_document; follow paging and report anything missing, unread, unavailable or unsupported. Never describe unread evidence as verified.

For each actionable fix, first read that saved section with read_authoring_section. Return at most six separate fenced blocks labelled authoring-remedy, each containing one JSON object with sectionId (the actual UUID), baseSha256 (the stored sha256 returned by the reader) and/or baseUpdatedAt (its updatedAt), quote (an exact passage in one paragraph or table cell), replacement (the proposed text, or an empty string to delete), and reason. Include prefix and suffix if needed to distinguish repeated quotes. Do not invent a base version, quote, number or source. Explain evidence gaps separately instead of inventing replacements. These are proposals for tracked changes: do not save, accept, approve or file them.

limitations: Working scaffold, not an approval, verified evidence or a filing-readiness decision.
